one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: B2B manufacturer of long and flat stainless-steel products (billets, ingots, black/bright bars, flat & patti) under the 'RSL' brand across 80+ grades.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Rajputana Stainless manufactures long and flat stainless-steel products - billets, forging ingots, rolled black bar, rolled bright bar, flat & patti, wire rods and ancillary products - in over 80 grades under the 'RSL' brand. It operates exclusively B2B, supplying manufacturers and traders across bar processing, seamless pipes, forging, wire, engineering, casting, fasteners, utensils, pump/shaft and auto industries, primarily in India with exports to nine countries.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Long products:** Billets, Forging ingots, Rolled black bar, Rolled bright bar, Wire rods
- **Flat products:** Flat & patti
- **Ancillary:** Consumables, Scrap, Traded goods, Job work

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Bar processing
- Seamless pipes
- Forging
- Wire manufacturing
- Engineering
- Casting
- Fasteners
- Utensils manufacturing
- Pump and shaft
- Auto industry

certifications.title: Certs (RHP)
certifications.body:
- ISO 9001:2015
- AD 2000-Merkblatt W0 (TUV NORD Systems, material manufacturer)
- IS 6603:2001 (Bureau of Indian Standards)
- AS 9100D (TUV India, aerospace application)

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward: imports ~26-49% of raw material (SS scrap, mild steel scrap) chiefly from UAE, Malaysia, South Korea. Forward: proposed SS seamless pipes unit (9,600 MTPA) using in-house rolled bar as feedstock (forward integration, key object of the fresh issue). Also engages third-party job-work units (Maharashtra/MP/Gujarat) for conversion of black bar to bright bar, billets to wire rods.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Domestic-driven revenue mix (98-100% domestic)
- Customer concentration in top-10 manufacturers
- Improving EBITDA margin trend (4.63% FY23 to 7.92% FY25)
- Working-capital and debt reduction (D/E fell from 0.98 to 0.66)
- Job-work outsourcing to flex capacity

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Forward integration into Stainless Steel Seamless Pipes via expansion at Panchmahal facility
- Diversification of product portfolio
- Deepening domestic B2B customer relationships and expanding traders' network
- Growing export presence beyond existing nine countries

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Expansion of the existing Panchmahal (Kalol), Gujarat manufacturing facility through forward integration and product diversification into Stainless Steel Seamless Pipes (the 'Proposed Facility'), with estimated cost of Rs 1,857.17 lakhs per a TEV report dated February 13, 2026.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Established integrated manufacturing setup covering melting to bright bar at a single strategic Gujarat location
- Diverse product portfolio across 80+ stainless-steel grades serving multiple end-industries
- Over two decades of manufacturing track record (5.50 lakh MT produced FY2006-FY2025)
- Long-standing customer relationships - 167 of 370 customers associated 3+ years, contributing 75.83% of FY25 revenue
- In-house oxygen and nitrogen plants reducing third-party dependence

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Customer concentration — Significant revenue from top 10 customers with no long-term contracts
- Domestic market dependence — 98-100% of revenue is domestic; limited geographic diversification
- Raw material / SS price volatility — Stainless-steel and scrap input prices drive margins in a thin-margin business
- Geographic revenue concentration — Maharashtra, Gujarat and UP contribute ~90% of revenue
- Single manufacturing facility — Operations concentrated at one Gujarat plant; disruption risk
- Legacy sick-unit history — Company was classified a Non-BIFR Sick Industrial Unit in 1999 before revival

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Set up Stainless Steel Seamless Pipes facility via forward integration and diversification at the Panchmahal, Gujarat manufacturing facility.**
- **Full or part repayment/prepayment of certain outstanding borrowings from Fresh Issue net proceeds.**
- **Diversify product portfolio through the new seamless pipes line.**
- **Expand exports beyond the existing nine countries.**

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Forward integration into Stainless Steel Seamless Pipes via expansion at Panchmahal facility
- Diversification of product portfolio
- Deepening domestic B2B customer relationships and expanding traders' network
- Growing export presence beyond existing nine countries
